top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide rooms that can be unlocked from inside without a key.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Properly select, install, inspect, or maintain portable fire extinguishes.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

top_deficiency_types.title: Allow resident to participate in the development and implementation of his or her person-centered plan of care.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
